inputs.original_text: These radical leftists can't protest without it spiraling into lawlessness every time. Their massive anti-Trump event started as a so-called "No Kings" rally but packed the streets and turned volatile fast, with agitators clashing against federal officers and forcing the police to step in with tear gas, arrests, and dispersal orders to restore basic order. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver. This is the predictable result when people reject authority, personal responsibility, and the social order that holds our traditions together.
inputs.modified_text: The "No Kings" rally against Trump drew massive crowds that packed the streets to push back against his harmful agenda, but it turned volatile fast when clashes broke out with federal officers. Police responded by deploying tear gas, making arrests, and issuing dispersal orders. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver. This is the predictable result of entrenched institutions using force to defend systemic inequality and suppress movements demanding real justice and protection for vulnerable communities.
